analyst_view.overall: Early view: two sides on one point who need a win to get back towards the play-off places. Iberia 1999 lost 2-0 at Sint-Truiden, drew with Mjällby and lost 2-1 in Copenhagen; Getafe drew at Craiova, were beaten 5-2 at home by Lugano and lost 1-0 to Brighton. Getafe are 15th in La Liga with only eight goals in 12 games, which shapes most of this view.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. I lean lower: Getafe have scored only eight goals in 12 La Liga games and Iberia have managed two in three European games. The 5-2 home defeat to Lugano was an outlier; Getafe's league games have averaged just over two goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.6 corners, more for Getafe. Nothing I read changes how either team builds attacks, so I stay with the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.9 cards, already a high figure that reflects Getafe's combative style. Both sides are desperate for points, which supports a high count, but the number already allows for that and there is no referee yet.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.0 shots, 15.9 for Getafe. I lean lower: Getafe's attack has been among La Liga's weakest, and Iberia have been outshot in their European games. Getafe did create chances against Brighton, with Jaouen Hadjam hitting the woodwork twice, but I expect fewer attempts in total than the number.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.0 shots on target. With two struggling attacks I lean slightly lower; Getafe's eight league goals in 12 games point to poor shot quality, not just bad luck.
